context: A sortable table of 20 synthetic book chapters showing word count, a sentence-length sparkline (sequence order), and a KDE violin plot (distribution) per chapter
first_impression: Structurally honest visualization with data-driven scales and principled bandwidth selection throughout.
what_works: All scale domains are data-derived (d3.extent/d3.max on actual data, no magic numbers); Silverman's rule drives KDE bandwidth; shared sentenceLenExtent ensures cross-chapter sparklines and violins are directly comparable; key function d => d.id is correctly used on row join for object constancy during sorting
what_doesnt: No line.defined() guard on sparklines — though synthetic data has no gaps, the omission is structurally incomplete; pre-computed chapterKDE array is static and would not update if chapters data changed at runtime, making the subset metamorphic relation fragile
